title: IEEE 802.11: Extend RSNX to dissect octet 2
description: Adds dissecting for new 802.11az fields introduced in RSNX octet 2. Refactors existing code to allow modular expansion of this and future octets, similar to how octets are handled for Extended Capabilities.
